## Youth who act, communities that move

Megh Foundation campaigns turn awareness into action - bringing young volunteers and participants together to run outreach, enrollment, and information drives.

## Typical campaign formats

- Community visits and outreach
- Digital awareness sessions
- Enrollment drives for programs
- Youth forums and dialogues

## Why it matters

Awareness is often the first barrier. When young people learn their rights, opportunities, and pathways, they begin to take the next step toward education, skilling, and dignified work.
